description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201 and other Title Settlement
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
